unauthorized.title: Unauthorized
unauthorized.description: You need to sign in to access this page.

forbidden.title: Access forbidden
forbidden.description: You don't have permission to access this resource.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

general.title: Something went wrong
general.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

maintenance.title: Under maintenance
maintenance.description: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please check back soon.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use your Google account to access safely.ink.

signOutDialog.title: Sign out?
signOutDialog.description: You'll need to sign in again to access the dashboard.

newAnalysis.title: Check a document
newAnalysis.subtitle: Upload a policy or contract and safely.ink will stress-test it with tricky scenarios.

upload.choose: Choose a PDF or page photos, or drop them here
upload.limits: One PDF, or 1 to 30 images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC). Up to 30 MB and 100 pages.

notices.notLegalAdvice: safely.ink is not legal advice. It shows where the wording may leave you worse off; a lawyer decides what that means for you.
notices.data: Your document is private to your account. The uploaded file is deleted after 7 days.

upload.readingHint: This can take a minute or two. Keep this page open.

errors.unsupported_type: That file type is not supported. Upload one PDF, or images in JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
errors.mixed_input: Upload either one PDF or page photos, not both.
errors.too_many_files: You can upload up to 30 images. Upload the main document only.
errors.too_large: The upload is over 30 MB. Upload the main document only.
errors.too_many_pages: The document has more than 100 pages. Upload the main document only.
errors.file_missing: One of the files did not upload. Please try again.
errors.daily_limit: You can check 10 documents a day. The limit resets at {{resetAt}}.
errors.failed: The upload did not go through. Check your connection and try again.

reading.title: Reading your document
reading.description: We are finding the clauses and the details. This page updates on its own.

rejected.title: Not a policy or contract
rejected.description: This doesn't look like a policy or contract. safely.ink checks documents that set out rights and obligations between you and another party.

unreadable.title: Some pages could not be read
unreadable.description: Page {{pages}} is blurred, cut off or too dark. You can continue with the rest, and the report will be marked as incomplete.

confirm.eyebrow: Check what we found before we continue
confirm.generalAnalysis: This type is checked with the general rules, and the report will be labelled as a general analysis.
confirm.lawSkipped: We do not compare against the law of {{country}} yet. The scenarios still run; only the legal comparison is skipped.
confirm.failed: Could not save the details. Please try again.

reading.title: Reading did not finish
reading.description: Something went wrong while reading the document. Nothing was lost on your side; please upload it again.

rules.title: The rules could not be worked out
rules.description: Something went wrong while we turned the clauses into rules. This run does not count against your daily limit; please upload the document again.

extractingRules.title: Working out the rules
extractingRules.description: We are turning the clauses into rules that can be tested. This can take a minute or two. This page updates on its own.

rulesReady.title: We have read your document
rulesReady.description: We found {{count}} rules in it. Testing them against real-life situations is the next step, and it is not available yet.

rules.empty: The rules of this document are not ready yet.

benefit.title: What you get
benefit.description: Something the document gives you or lets you do.

exclusion.title: When it does not apply
exclusion.description: Situations in which you do not get a benefit.

condition.title: What you must have done
condition.description: If you have not, it counts against you.

deadline.title: Time limits on you
deadline.description: Miss one and it counts against you.

limit.title: Caps and deductions
limit.description: What reduces the amount you get.

charge.title: What you may have to pay
charge.description: Fees and penalties, and what triggers them.

unmodeled.title: Read these yourself
unmodeled.description: These clauses matter, but they depend on a judgement or on vague wording, so we cannot test them. Read the clause.

facts.title: The facts we look at
facts.description: Every rule above is written with these facts. Each test situation gives every one of them a value.
